scenarios.title: Chào buổi sáng ở văn phòng
scenarios.description: Morning at the office. You meet a colleague near the lift.
scenarios.task: greet Lan, ask how she is, answer her questions and say goodbye
scenarios.openingLine: Good morning! How are you today?

scenarios.title: Ngày đầu đi làm
scenarios.description: First day at a new company. A colleague comes to say hello.
scenarios.task: introduce yourself: your name, job, where you are from and where you live
scenarios.openingLine: Hi! I'm Minh. Are you new here?

scenarios.title: Giới thiệu đồng nghiệp
scenarios.description: You are with your colleague Peter. You meet your manager in the corridor.
scenarios.task: introduce your colleague Peter to the manager: his name, job and country
scenarios.openingLine: Oh, hello! Who is this?

scenarios.title: Điền thông tin ở lễ tân
scenarios.description: At the reception desk of a gym. The receptionist fills in a form for you.
scenarios.task: answer questions about your name (spell it), phone number, age and email
scenarios.openingLine: Hello! Welcome to City Gym. What's your name, please?

scenarios.title: Ảnh gia đình
scenarios.description: At lunch. A colleague sees a family photo on your phone.
scenarios.task: talk about your family: who is in the photo, their jobs and ages
scenarios.openingLine: Oh, nice photo! Is this your family?

scenarios.title: Cuối tuần bạn làm gì?
scenarios.description: Coffee break. A colleague asks about your free time.
scenarios.task: say what you like doing in your free time and ask Nam about his hobbies
scenarios.openingLine: So, what do you do in your free time?

scenarios.title: Bạn làm nghề gì?
scenarios.description: At a friend's party you meet someone new.
scenarios.role: a guest at a party called Anna
scenarios.task: say what you do, where you work and what your office is like
scenarios.openingLine: Hi, I'm Anna. Nice to meet you! What do you do?

scenarios.title: Hỏi đường trong tòa nhà
scenarios.description: You are a visitor in a big office building. You talk to the security guard.
scenarios.task: ask where the meeting room, the toilets and the cafe are, and say thank you
scenarios.openingLine: Good morning. Can I help you?

scenarios.title: Mượn đồ đồng nghiệp
scenarios.description: At your desk. You need a pen and a charger.
scenarios.task: ask to borrow a pen and a phone charger, and thank him
scenarios.openingLine: Hi! You look busy. Do you need something?

scenarios.title: Kiểm tra tuần 1: Gặp đồng nghiệp mới
scenarios.description: Your first week at a new company. A colleague from another team sits next to you at lunch.
scenarios.role: a friendly colleague called Linh from the sales team
scenarios.task: greet Linh, introduce yourself (name, job, where you are from), talk about your family and one hobby, and ask Linh one question about her
scenarios.openingLine: Hi! I don't think we've met. I'm Linh. Are you new here?

scenarios.title: Lịch làm việc hằng ngày
scenarios.description: A new colleague asks about a normal working day in the company.
scenarios.task: describe your daily work schedule: start time, lunch, meetings and finish time
scenarios.openingLine: Hi! I'm new here. What time do you start work?

scenarios.title: Xin nghỉ phép
scenarios.description: You go to your manager's office to ask for a day off.
scenarios.task: ask for a day off: say the date and the reason, and who can do your work
targetPatterns: Can I take a day off on ...?
scenarios.openingLine: Come in! What can I do for you?

scenarios.title: Hẹn lịch họp
scenarios.description: On the phone with a client. You need to arrange a meeting.
scenarios.task: agree on a day, a time and a place for a meeting
scenarios.openingLine: Hello, this is Jane Smith. You wanted to meet?

scenarios.title: Đặt bàn nhà hàng
scenarios.description: You phone a restaurant to book a table for dinner.
scenarios.role: a restaurant waiter on the phone
scenarios.task: book a table: day, time, number of people and your name and phone number
targetPatterns: I'd like to book a table for ...
scenarios.openingLine: Good afternoon, Saigon Garden restaurant. How can I help you?

scenarios.title: Gọi món
scenarios.description: In a restaurant. The waiter comes to your table.
scenarios.task: order a main dish and a drink, and ask a question about the menu
scenarios.openingLine: Hello! Are you ready to order?

scenarios.title: Thanh toán hóa đơn
scenarios.description: At the end of the meal you want to pay.
scenarios.task: ask for the bill, check the price and pay by card
targetPatterns: Can I have the bill, please?
scenarios.openingLine: Did you enjoy your meal?

scenarios.title: Hỏi giá
scenarios.description: At a market stall that sells fruit and T-shirts.
scenarios.task: ask the price of two things, ask for a lower price and buy one
scenarios.openingLine: Hello! Fresh mangoes and nice T-shirts! What do you need?

scenarios.title: Chọn cỡ quần áo
scenarios.description: In a clothes shop. You want a shirt.
scenarios.task: ask for a shirt in your size and colour, try it on and say if it fits
scenarios.openingLine: Hi there! Can I help you?

scenarios.title: Đổi trả hàng
scenarios.description: You go back to a shop with a jacket you bought yesterday.
scenarios.task: return the jacket: say what is wrong, show the receipt and ask for a refund or another one
targetPatterns: Can I change it / get a refund?
scenarios.openingLine: Good morning. How can I help you?

scenarios.title: Kiểm tra tuần 2: Một ngày làm việc
scenarios.description: Friday at work. Your manager wants to plan next week and lunch.
scenarios.task: say what time you start and finish work, agree a time for a meeting, and choose and order food for a team lunch with a price
scenarios.openingLine: Good morning! Do you have a minute to plan next week?

scenarios.title: Hỏi đường
scenarios.description: You are lost in the city centre and stop a person in the street.
scenarios.role: a local person in the street
scenarios.task: ask the way to the post office, check the directions and say thank you
targetPatterns: Excuse me, how do I get to ...?
scenarios.openingLine: Hi! You look lost. Can I help you?

scenarios.title: Đi taxi
scenarios.description: You get into a taxi at the airport.
scenarios.task: say where you want to go, ask how long it takes and how much it costs
scenarios.openingLine: Good evening! Where to?

scenarios.title: Mua vé
scenarios.description: At the ticket office of a train station.
scenarios.task: buy two tickets: destination, day, time, one-way or return
scenarios.openingLine: Next, please! Where are you going?

scenarios.title: Làm thủ tục sân bay
scenarios.description: At the airport check-in desk.
scenarios.task: check in: show your passport, say how many bags you have and ask for a window seat
targetPatterns: Can I have a window seat?
scenarios.openingLine: Good morning. Can I see your passport, please?

scenarios.title: Nhận phòng khách sạn
scenarios.description: At the reception of a hotel in the evening.
scenarios.task: check in: give your name and booking, ask about breakfast time and Wi-Fi
scenarios.openingLine: Good evening and welcome! Do you have a booking?

scenarios.title: Giờ tàu xe
scenarios.description: At the bus station information desk.
scenarios.role: a person at an information desk
scenarios.task: ask when the next bus to the beach leaves, how long it takes and where it leaves from
targetPatterns: When is the next bus to ...?
scenarios.openingLine: Hello, how can I help?

scenarios.title: Đi khám bệnh
scenarios.description: At the doctor's. You don't feel well.
scenarios.task: describe your symptoms, say since when, and ask what you should do
targetPatterns: I have a headache / a cough.
scenarios.openingLine: Hello, please sit down. What's the problem?

scenarios.title: Mua thuốc
scenarios.description: At a pharmacy.
scenarios.task: ask for something for a cold, ask how often to take it and how much it is
targetPatterns: How often should I take it?
Can I take it with food?
scenarios.openingLine: Hi! How can I help you today?

scenarios.title: Ở ngân hàng
scenarios.description: At a bank counter.
scenarios.task: change 100 dollars into dong and ask about opening an account
scenarios.openingLine: Good morning. What can I do for you?

scenarios.title: Kiểm tra tuần 3: Chuyến công tác
scenarios.description: You arrive in Da Nang for a business trip. You call the hotel from the airport.
scenarios.task: say you have a booking, ask how to get to the hotel and how long it takes, and say you feel unwell and ask where a pharmacy is
scenarios.openingLine: Good afternoon, Sea View Hotel. How can I help you?

scenarios.title: Nhắn lại qua điện thoại
scenarios.description: You phone a company to speak to Mr Brown, but he is not there.
scenarios.task: ask for Mr Brown, leave a message with your name, number and why you called
targetPatterns: Please ask him to call me.
scenarios.openingLine: Good morning, Green Tech, Mai speaking.

scenarios.title: Lời mời
scenarios.description: A friend calls you on Friday.
scenarios.task: accept or politely refuse an invitation to a birthday party, and ask about time and place
scenarios.openingLine: Hi! Are you free on Saturday evening? It's my birthday!

scenarios.title: Hẹn gặp bạn
scenarios.description: Chatting with a friend about meeting this weekend.
scenarios.task: agree on when and where to meet and what to do
scenarios.openingLine: Hey! We haven't met for ages. Let's meet this weekend!

scenarios.title: Đổi kế hoạch
scenarios.description: You phone a friend because you can't come to your meeting tomorrow.
scenarios.task: say you can't come, explain why and suggest a new day and time
targetPatterns: I'm sorry, I can't come tomorrow.
scenarios.openingLine: Hi! See you tomorrow at the cinema, right?

scenarios.title: Nói chuyện thời tiết
scenarios.description: Waiting for the lift with a neighbour.
scenarios.task: make small talk about the weather today and tomorrow and your plans
scenarios.openingLine: Phew, it's so hot today, isn't it?

scenarios.title: Cuối tuần của bạn
scenarios.description: Monday morning at the office.
scenarios.task: talk about what you did last weekend and ask about his weekend
scenarios.openingLine: Good morning! How was your weekend?

scenarios.title: Gửi bưu kiện
scenarios.description: At the post office with a small box.
scenarios.task: send a parcel abroad: say where, ask how long it takes and how much it costs
targetPatterns: I'd like to send this to ...
scenarios.openingLine: Hello! What can I do for you?

scenarios.title: Báo sự cố
scenarios.description: You phone the IT help desk because your laptop doesn't work.
scenarios.task: describe the problem, say what you tried and when it started, and ask when they can fix it
scenarios.openingLine: IT help desk, this is Kevin. What's the problem?

scenarios.title: Gọi trợ giúp khẩn cấp
scenarios.description: Someone fell down in the street and is hurt. You call for help.
scenarios.task: say what happened, where you are and how the person is
scenarios.openingLine: Emergency services. What's happening?

scenarios.title: Kiểm tra tuần 4: Đổi kế hoạch
scenarios.description: A friend calls to invite you out this weekend, but you have a problem.
scenarios.task: accept or refuse the invitation politely, explain your problem, suggest another day and time, and agree a place to meet
scenarios.openingLine: Hi! Are you free on Saturday evening? Let's go to the cinema!
